name: WireGuard
author: Kike Ferrater
description: WireGuard tunnels from NetworkManager: bar indicator, one-click switching with a configurable default, a live traffic graph and verified exit IP.

barWidget.description: Status icon with a panel listing every WireGuard profile NetworkManager knows: switch tunnels, pick the default the switch and right-click bring up, watch a live traffic graph and verify the exit IP.

schema.label: Default tunnel
schema.description: NetworkManager connection name brought up by the power switch, a right-click on the bar icon and the IPC 'on' call. Empty: the first WireGuard profile.

schema.label: One tunnel at a time
schema.description: Bring every other tunnel down before bringing one up. Keep it on for full-tunnel gateways.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Toast after every connect, switch, disconnect or failure. The connect toast reports the exit IP once fetched and flags a mismatch with the gateway.
